source.title: European Rubik's Cube Championship 2010 on October 1-3, 2010 in Budapest, Hungary
source.content: The [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2010](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2010) will take place on October 1-3, 2010 in Budapest, Hungary. Check out the [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2010 website](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2010) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2010 年欧洲魔方锦标赛将于 10 月 1–3 日在匈牙利布达佩斯举行
translation.content: [2010 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2010)将于 2010 年 10 月 1–3 日在匈牙利布达佩斯举行。更多信息及报名请见[赛事网站](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/euro2010)。
